policy.name: quality_gate_policy_v2_revised
policy.basis: Formal owner decision after the provenance audit (part3_v2_gate_production_policy): B_wape <= 0.60 was classified as an engineering reference-anchored regression guard, not a documented business requirement. The revised policy reclassifies it as diagnostic/monitoring while preserving ALL other criteria unchanged.

blocking_criteria.justification: Frozen champion EXP2 = 0.3964 on val; winner reference 0.4001. A -2.5% band above reference (=0.41) rejects any regression worse than ~2.4% vs. the persisted production quality bar while absorbing test-split variance.

blocking_criteria.description: Global MAE (unit sales) - interpretable absolute error
blocking_criteria.justification: Reference MAE 0.0233-0.0235 units; 0.025 allows ~7% headroom for test-period noise yet rejects any accuracy collapse.
Reference RMSE 0.26-0.27; budget of 0.30 is ~+10% to keep outliers in check without over-fitting the threshold to one val snapshot.
Reference MASE ~0.61-0.62; 0.64 leaves ~3-4% band while preserving the 'well below naive (=1)' quality demonstration.
Reference bias -6..-9.6% (slight under-forecast). A symmetrical ±12% band bounds systematic under/over-forecasting - the business impact asymmetry is then handled by the 2:1 asym loss below.
Reference 0.037-0.038 cheap units; 0.04 is +~8% headroom; stricter than the raw pre-experiment score would already fail, guarding the stockout-cost asymmetry the metric encodes.

blocking_criteria.description: WAPE restricted to positive-demand rows (operational sellable demand)
blocking_criteria.justification: Positive-demand error budget 0.42 vs reference 0.365-0.372; +13% band keeps sellable-demand accuracy near the champion.

blocking_criteria.description: B cohort bias (%) - MUST NOT systematically under-forecast
blocking_criteria.justification: Key business requirement distilled from the defect analysis: the production winner under-forecast B by -30%; EXP2 repaired it to -18.2%. The gate mandates >= -20% - i.e. the candidate MUST hold the fix and may not slip back towards the -30% stockout regime.
B2 reference 0.56; 0.65 band = +16% regression guard for this secondary near-mature cohort.
Same stockout-risk requirement as B: the -28% production defect must stay fixed (>= -20%), matching the EXP2 result of -18.1%.

blocking_criteria.description: C long-tail cohort WAPE (sparse, many zero-weeks)
blocking_criteria.justification: Long tail (majority of 32.7k SKUs) must not be sacrificed for segment gains: 0.43 = +13% band over reference 0.38.
Rejects NaN/Inf/negative/shape-broken outputs before any scoring is trusted.

blocking_criteria.description: Model input schema == frozen 93-column signature (exact order)
blocking_criteria.justification: Schema drift silently corrupts inference; the gate enforces the frozen contract.
A logged model that cannot reload is not deployable regardless of metrics.

blocking_criteria.description: PyFunc predict returns pred_demand on unit scale
blocking_criteria.justification: End-to-end MLflow PyFunc contract must hold for the pipeline to be served.

blocking_criteria.description: MLflow model signature recorded and valid
blocking_criteria.justification: Signature drives downstream serving; its absence breaks the registry contract.

blocking_criteria.description: Model + feature_columns.json + config.json artifacts present in run
blocking_criteria.justification: Reproducibility requires the schema and freeze config shipped with the model.
The candidate must not corrupt the project's existing contracts.

diagnostic_metrics.description: B cohort WAPE (sustained high-volume, the business-critical segment)

notes: Formal quality-gate policy revision: B_wape <= 0.60 reclassified to a diagnostic/monitoring metric (b_wape_role=diagnostic) by owner decision after the provenance audit; B_bias_pct >= -20 and all other criteria unchanged and still blocking. Metrics are replayed from the persisted post-hoc evaluation report (no Test access, no retraining). V1 and historical reports/tags preserved.
